title: Who carries the most?
prompt: Read from standard input the food carried by a group of hikers. Each hiker's items are listed one per line (a non-negative whole number of calories); the lists of different hikers are separated by one or more blank lines. A line that is not a whole number (digits only) prints `line N: invalid` (N counts from 1) and is ignored, and it does not end a hiker's list. After the last line print three lines: `hikers=H` (how many hikers carry at least one valid item), `top1=A` (the largest total carried by one hiker) and `top3=B` (the sum of the three largest totals, or of all of them when there are fewer than three). With no valid item at all, print `hikers=0`, `top1=0` and `top3=0`.

cases.name: hidden2
cases.expected_output:
line 2: invalid
line 8: invalid
line 9: invalid
hikers=3
top1=10
top3=28
